# Source: https://github.com/oshi/oshi/pull/3086 (Arc A770 16 GB; MemorySize holds 0x7FFFF000)
# HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4d36e968-e325-11ce-bfc1-08002be10318}\0000
# The 4-byte value saturates near 2 GiB, so the card reads as 2 GB. qwMemorySize is absent here.
DriverDesc REG_SZ "Intel(R) Arc(TM) A770 Graphics"
ProviderName REG_SZ "Intel Corporation"
HardwareInformation.MemorySize REG_BINARY 00 f0 ff 7f
